name: render
description: Connect Render to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Render MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Render to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with services, deploys and logs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Render workspace.
Find anything in Render that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review services, deploys and logs in Render.
